title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
notes: claim 68: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default, licensing and survey control are supported. The admin path is documented across two cited Microsoft pages, so the pre-check's missing words are not an error. The impact rationale should remove its unsupported assurance that administrators and other users do not otherwise notice the change.
